text: EXACT 76c62e7 COVERAGE AUDIT, refining the owner acceptance note. Missing executable capability pages or visible worked sections: canonical PropositionChart; PENMAN/AMR checked conversion; acquire proposal/critic/resolution and valid/partial/refused outcomes; document mention graph/coreference projection; general feature tracks/windows/coverage/derivation; grakern structural channel; posterior transition flow F and cross-page causal/world-time visualization; the multi-outcome output bundle/view lowering rather than StoryModel JSON alone.
